notes.title: Before Fate Limited Time Demo 1.0.73 Patch Update
notes.notes:
Hello, researchers! Here’s what's new in the latest update for [i]Before Fate[/i]:

[b][B4F8] Patch Update v1.0.73[/b]

[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed AI pathfinding ignoring obstacles on the far left side of the town.
[*] Fixed issue where immobile monsters could cause the game to crash.
[*] Corrected torch overlapping issue.
[*] Fixed hunger buff not displaying when weakened.
[*] Fixed guide weapon sway and trajectory jittering in auto-aim mode.
[/list]
[b]Adjustments[/b]
[list]
[*] Invisible enemies will now show hit effects when detected by sensors.
[*] Unarmed attacks and some other attacks will now have directional targeting.
[*] In auto-aim mode, the character will maintain aim for a period after attacking.
[*] Advanced recipes no longer require crafting the previous tier; having the recipe alone is sufficient for activation.
[/list]
[b]UI[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed the prompt button not properly graying out when the Neogen System cannot activate projects.
[*] Fixed the prompt button not properly graying out for unbound key options in the control settings.
[*] Differentiated the UI color for energy weapon and ammo weapon capacity.
[/list]
[b]Scenes[/b]
[list]
[*] Optimized map area notifications for the Forest Whisperer Tribe Ruins.
[*] The AI pathfinding in each large scene is carried out in partitions. If it exceeds a certain range, it will be out of combat state.
[/list]

notes.title: Before Fate Limited Time Demo 1.0.72 Minor Patch Update
notes.notes:
Dear Researchers,

Thank you for your valuable feedback on the [i]Before Fate[/i] demo! We appreciate every opinion and will continue to update the game during the demo period to ensure the best gaming experience. Here are the main updates in version [b]1.0.72[/b]:

[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Addressed performance issues causing noticeable lag when a large number of buffs are active.
[*] Resolved issues with filter effects failing to transition properly between scenes (now directly switches to the target effect).
[*] Corrected visual rendering issues where invincibility effects caused incorrect display of dark buff when switching scenes.
[/list]
[b]Adjustments[/b]
[list]
[*] Enhanced combat experience with the final two monsters in the prologue.
[*] Disabled all accessory effect displays upon character death.
[*] Improved transition effect of the white screen when awakening at the start of the prologue.
[*] Refined flashlight effects.
[*] Accelerated text display speed; now significantly faster, with consistent text speed in Simplified and Traditional Chinese.
[*] Adjusted walking sound volume from 0.25 to 0.15.
[/list]
[b]Controls[/b]
[list]
[*] Optimized mouse aiming for smoother performance.
[*] Enhanced controls settings with a confirmation dialog for changes; changes will only be applied after confirmation, preventing unintended alterations.
[/list]
We will continuously adjust and improve the game based on your feedback. If you encounter any issues or have further suggestions, please use the [b]in-game feedback[/b] form to let us know, and we will work on improvements as soon as possible.

We hope you continue to enjoy your adventure in [i]Before Fate[/i]!

Best regards,

The Before Fate Team

notes.title: Before Fate Limited Demo 1.0.71 Minor Patch Update
notes.notes:
Dear Researchers,

To enhance your gameplay experience, we have released a minor patch update for the Before Fate Limited Demo, version 1.0.71. Here are the details of this update:

[b]Graphics Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] Enhanced anti-aliasing effects for smoother visuals.
[*] Optimized bloom effects for a more natural light and shadow representation.
[*] Added small flashing indicators for collectible objects to aid discovery and interaction.
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed pathfinding issues where the protagonist and NPCs could not navigate properly in certain scenes.
[*] Resolved the issue where the starting time of the prologue was not fixed to daytime, ensuring consistent starting conditions.
[/list]
[b]Other Adjustments[/b]
[list]
[*] Made adjustments to certain story elements and text to improve the flow and narrative experience.
[*] Updated default shortcuts for the keyboard & mouse quick bar from 5, 6 to F, G to better align with user preferences.
[/list]
We appreciate your continued support and feedback. If you encounter any issues or have further suggestions, please use the [b]in-game feedback[/b] form to let us know, and we will work on improvements as soon as possible.

We hope you continue to enjoy your adventure in Before Fate!

Best regards,

The Before Fate Team
